_comment: Players who join the WNBA pool REGARDLESS of the MPG>=16 / G>=20 rule. This file COMPOSES with that rule rather than replacing it: scripts/cardgen/wnba/generateWnbaCards.js keeps everyone the rule already admits and adds everyone named here, so an entry can only ever ADD a player. Keyed by the player name exactly as Basketball-Reference's WNBA per-game table spells it; a name matching no row is reported and the run exits non-zero rather than leaving the pool quietly one player short. WHY THESE NINE: every one of them clears the MPG half of the rule and is dropped by the G>=20 half alone — the half that cannot tell a bad player from a short season. Seven are injury exceptions, and were chosen against the standard the NBA pool's were: a 25+ MPG player when healthy. THE OTHER TWO ARE DIRECT USER PICKS and are recorded as what they are rather than dressed up as injury cases. DiJonai Carrington is not that player — 16.2 MPG off the Chicago bench in 2026, 21.9 across Dallas and Minnesota in 2025 — and what makes her cardable on the same terms is the blend below: 11 games is too thin, 42 is not. RICKEA JACKSON WAS REFUSED HERE ONCE, on the stated ground that 4 G was 'too thin to card on EVEN WITH a blend'. That ground did not survive its own precedent: blended she is 4 G (2026) + 38 G (2025) = 42 games, the SAME sample this file already called sufficient for Carrington. The real caveat is different and is worth stating instead — only 4 of her 42 games are current-season, so her card is ~90% her 2025 Sparks season, where Carrington's is a fuller mix. SATOU SABALLY needed no such argument and is filed as the seventh injury exception rather than as a third user pick: she was ASKED FOR by name, but she meets the 25+ MPG-when-healthy standard on her own at 26.6 MPG across a full 39-game 2025, and blended she is 52 games — a deeper sample than either user pick. Deliberately still NOT included: Kara Dunn (1 G), who is thin even blended. THEIR NUMBERS ARE BLENDED, unlike the NBA's: each of these nine is carded on 2025 AND 2026 pooled by volume, per stat, against the denominator each stat is a rate over (possessions for per-100 and rate percentages, the relevant attempts for each shooting percentage, minutes for per-four-minute production, sums for season totals). That blend is possible here and blocked on the NBA side for one reason only — Basketball-Reference publishes WNBA 2025 in full and for free, where dunksandthrees paywalls prior NBA seasons. See scripts/cardgen/wnba/pool.js.
Satou Sabally: injury-shortened 2026: 13 G at 16.8 MPG with New York, blended with a full 39 G at 26.6 in 2025 — meets the 25+ MPG when healthy standard on the 2025 season
DiJonai Carrington: user pick, not an injury case: 11 G at 16.2 MPG in 2026, blended with 31 G at 21.9 in 2025
Rickea Jackson: user pick: 4 G at 29.5 MPG in 2026 after the move to Chicago, blended with 38 G at 30.9 in 2025 — 42 games, the same blended sample as Carrington, but only 4 of them current-season
